record.question: Present Secretary General of United Nations is
record.explanation: Answer C: Ban Ki Moon. Ban Ki-moon served as UN Secretary-General from January 2007 to December 2016, covering this June 2014 examination. The other printed persons were not the Secretary-General then. Historical/source note: Present refers to June 2014, not the date the question is viewed. Reference: https://www.un.org/sg/en/content/former-secretaries-general. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
